summary: Outset horizontal tab group for switching adjacent local panels on basic application surfaces.
useWhen: Adjacent local panels need a prominent navigation row with full control-height selected tabs.
A horizontal tab row has room for an outset shell rather than needing to align beside compact controls.
avoidWhen: The tab row must sit inline with ordinary controls; use TabGroup's compact segmented presentation instead.
The row sits on bold, strong, media, inverted, or other specialized surfaces; this treatment is intended for basic application backgrounds.
The choices navigate application routes rather than switching local panels; use PanelNav or BarNav.

alternatives.when: A compact selector must align beside other controls or support specialized surface contexts.
alternatives.reason: TabGroup provides control-height segmented chrome and surface-aware selection.

alternatives.when: The choices are application destinations rather than local panels.
alternatives.reason: PanelNav owns application navigation semantics and route selection.

accessibility: Provide an accessible name for the delegated tab list with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
TabGroup owns tab semantics, roving focus, arrow-key selection, and inactive-tab behavior; the navigation wrapper must not create a second tab or event stream.
Keep the selected local panel synchronized with dsChange and connect each tab to its panel when panels are present.
states: The parent owns which adjacent panel is visible; user activation updates the mutable selected value and emits dsChange once through the wrapper.
The selected tab uses the normal control-density height and primary surface with medium elevation inside an outset, padded shell.
The navigation treatment delegates its tab items, selection, focus, and keyboard behavior to TabGroup rather than maintaining a parallel implementation.
responsiveBehavior: The group stays on one horizontal row; choose the control density and bounded width to fit the available layout.
Hug follows content width and fill distributes selectable tabs evenly across a definite parent width.

customElements: Assign tabs as a JavaScript property and keep the selected panel synchronized with dsChange.
react: Pass tabs as an array through the generated wrapper and handle onDsChange to update the visible panel.
vue: Use v-model for the selected value and pass tabs as a property-bound array.
angular: Bind tabs and value as properties and handle dsChange to update the visible panel.

styling.rationale: The component owns its outset shell and selected-tab treatment through TabGroup's shared tab anatomy; applications own the surrounding basic surface and panel layout.

protected.reason: The shell and selected tab form one density-specific navigation recipe; choose size and width instead of restyling nested tabs.
